name: dev.ucp.shopping.seller_disclosure
title: Seller Disclosure Extension
description: Adds a response-only `seller_disclosures` map to cart, checkout, and order. Each entry states who sells one or more line items: the seller's declared trader status, legal identity, address, contact channels, and public registrations. The order carries the disclosures as presented at checkout.

seller_entry.title: Seller Disclosure Entry
seller_entry.description: Disclosure for one seller in the session, and the line items that seller sells.

line_item_ids.description: IDs of the line items this seller sells. When omitted, the entry covers every line item. A line item MUST NOT be covered by more than one entry.

seller_disclosures.description: Sellers in this session, keyed by a Business-scoped seller ID that stays stable across the cart, checkout, and resulting order.

dev.ucp.shopping.order.title: Order with Seller Disclosure
dev.ucp.shopping.order.description: Order extended with the per-seller disclosures presented at checkout.
